directAnswer: To reset an AI agent, locate the reset option in the agent's settings menu, or use a specific command in the user interface, depending on the platform.
summary: Resetting an AI agent can help resolve issues or refresh its state. The method varies by platform.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The steps to reset an AI agent differ based on the platform you are using. Below are instructions for some common platforms.

sections.heading: Caveats
sections.body: Resetting an AI agent may result in loss of custom configurations or learned data.

steps.title: Reset on Platform A
steps.detail: Go to Settings > AI Agent > Reset. Confirm the action when prompted.

steps.title: Reset on Platform B
steps.detail: Use the command 'reset agent' in the console. Ensure you have admin privileges.

steps.title: Reset on Platform C
steps.detail: Navigate to the agent's profile and select 'Factory Reset' from the options.

faqs.question: Will resetting the AI agent delete all my data?
faqs.answer: Yes, resetting may remove all custom configurations and learned data specific to that agent.

faqs.question: Can I undo the reset process?
faqs.answer: No, once the reset is completed, it cannot be undone.

faqs.question: How often should I reset my AI agent?
faqs.answer: It depends on the performance issues you encounter; consider resetting if the agent behaves unexpectedly.

caveats: Resetting may lead to loss of personalized settings and data.
Ensure you back up any important information before proceeding.
